title: Jangada Sailing
summary: A raft of lashed logs under a triangular sail: fishermen race home along the shore, trimming the cloth to every shift of the sea breeze.
howToPlay: Hold the left or the right side to ease or haul the sail.
Keep the white dot on the gold marker: it follows the wind as it shifts.
Stay on the marker as you round the buoys.
rules: Speed comes from how well the sail matches the wind.
The current gives every boat a small push.
Stars: first with a steady trim for three; first alone for two; on the podium for one.
heritageNote: Fishermen of the north-east coast of Brazil sail rafts made of logs, steering with a long oar and moving their weight to balance the sail. Regattas show off the old skill.
